response_text:

Based on industry standards and creator workflows, here is a guide to the best software tools, key options, and an efficient workflow method tailored for your needs.

### Key Industry Software Options

When it comes to removing filler words, AI-driven text-based editing has revolutionized the workflow. Here are the top tools currently used by creators:

1. **Descript (The Gold Standard for Text-Based Editing)**
   * **Why use it:** Descript pioneered the "edit audio/video by editing text" workflow. It automatically transcribes your footage and identifies filler words. With a single click, you can remove all filler words or "studio sound" your audio.
